summary: The patch addresses the issue by modifying the linkcheck behavior to handle HTTP errors correctly. It introduces new files for reproduction and testing.

issues.description: The patch introduces new files (`reproduce.py` and `test_edge_cases.py`) that follow the naming convention of existing test files but do not match the style or structure of the rest of the test suite.
The code could benefit from additional comments to explain the logic, especially around the handling of HEAD and GET requests.
